title: WRSI water requirement satisfaction index (FEWS NET)
description: Cropland and rangeland water requirement satisfaction index from USGS/FEWS NET, for the KE-ENSO agriculture layer.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: Only the rangeland-MAM series (FEWS e2, end-of-season dekad 21) extends to 2026; the other three series reach 2026 once their end-of-season dekad (33/36) is published, typically late November to January.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.

Cropland/rangeland labels found inverted: REGION_MAP served FEWS e1/e2 (rangeland) as cropland and ek/et as rangeland. Fixed in python/ingest_wrsi_fews.py (e1/e2 -> rangeland, ee/et -> cropland, ek dropped).

Rebaked all 93 files with the corrected map and republished in place to S3 (93/93 md5 verified); the stale cropland_MAM_2026 object was deleted. Ingest now removes a stale local file when --overwrite finds no upstream product.

acquire.note: Registered ingest. The script is the definition of the dataset; do not fetch these by any other route.
